annotations.title: Create a Zero to Hundred draft listing

description: Create an invisible draft and return editUrl and publishUrl. Price and source inclusion are Builder decisions. Set sourceCodeIncluded only after confirmation; omitted values default to false. Requires listings:write. Returns the draft identity and web edit/review links. Supply a stable idempotencyKey and reuse it on every retry. The same key returns the original draft without editing it. Without a key, check z2h_list_my_listings before retrying. Source delivery, review and publishing continue in the web wizard.

askingPrice.description: USD license price confirmed by the Builder. Omit if undecided.

associatedListingIds.description: IDs of related listings owned by this Builder, obtained from z2h_list_my_listings.

demoUrl.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS demo URL. Omit when no demo is available.

domains.description: Industry tags for the software. Choose keys from the Zero to Hundred taxonomy: ai, analytics, art-design, auth-identity, cms, conference, developer-tools, devops, e-commerce-marketplace, education, entertainment, environmental, fashion, finance, food, gaming, graphic-design, health, interior-design, marketing, membership, messaging, non-profit, political, productivity, real-estate, religious, services, social, technology, travel, ux-ui, wedding, other. Omission creates a draft without industry tags.

externalDependencies.description: Third-party services a Buyer must provision. Common values: Supabase, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Upstash, Firebase, PlanetScale, Neon, Clerk, Auth0, Stripe, PayPal, Plaid, Resend, SendGrid, Postmark, Twilio, OpenAI, Anthropic.

cost.description: Expected service cost, such as USD 20/month.

name.description: Name of a service the Buyer needs to operate the software, such as Stripe.

note.description: What the software needs this service for.

faqs.description: Supplying FAQs disables the automatic FAQ draft.

question.description: Buyer question addressed by the paired answer.

idempotencyKey.description: Choose one random key for this new listing and reuse it on every retry. Replays return the original draft without applying changes. Use update for edits. A new key means a deliberately new listing.

imageUrls.description: HTTP or HTTPS screenshot URLs. The first image becomes the thumbnail.

longDescription.description: What the software does, who it helps, and what the Buyer receives.

operatingStatus.description: State of the software itself, independent of the listing publication status.

shortDescription.description: Buyer-facing summary shown on marketplace cards.

sourceCodeIncluded.description: Whether the sale includes source code. Omission records false. Set true only after the Builder confirms that source code is included.

sourceRepoUrl.description: GitHub repository URL. Connecting and verifying source continues in the web wizard.

techStack.description: Frameworks and languages used by the software.

thumbnailUrl.description: HTTP or HTTPS image URL for the marketplace thumbnail.

title.description: Name Buyers will see on the software listing.

type.description: Software category that best matches its main use.

videoUploadUrl.description: A YouTube or Loom demo URL.

name: z2h_create_draft_listing

createdAt.description: ISO creation timestamp, returned when creating a draft.

editUrl.description: Web wizard URL for editing this listing.

publishUrl.description: Web review step where the Builder finishes publishing.

slug.description: Listing identifier used by the other Builder tools.

status.description: Listing publication state. Only drafts can be edited through MCP.

termsAcceptance.description: Present when the Builder needs to accept terms before publishing.

acceptUrl.description: Website URL where the Builder accepts the terms.

required.description: The Builder must accept current terms in the website before publishing.
